title: IVG Intense Salts Summer Blaze 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Summer Blaze captures the taste of Sicilian-style Lemonade blended with ripe summer Berries. The Lemonade provides a crisp citrus base with a subtle fizz, while the mixed fruits add sweetness and depth for a flavour that’s bright and refreshing. Balanced at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt delivers clear flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Summer Blaze is best suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits, pens and starter devices. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Summer Blaze offers a sun-soaked combination of citrus and berry tones for fans of drink-inspired flavours.
